{{Quote|Prepare to move the Sullust Fleet to Rhen Var.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''Sullust Fleet''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Following the [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|second battle]] of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] prepared to mobilize the Sullust Fleet to Rhen Var, presuming [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had failed in their mission.<ref name="Clone Wars" />
